title: Armor Test

source.basis: Manufactured under R0.3 as the test card of pass 26 of the Card Play and Map Studio Redesign Plan (ruling R26.7): it fields vehicles and Guns from setup to exit. It is not a published scenario.
source.legacy: None: a manufactured test card (R0.3; ruling R26.7), adapting no legacy card
adaptation: Every fact of the card is manufactured under R0.3: the forces, the areas, the turns, and the Victory Conditions were chosen to exercise vehicles entering loaded and towing, Passengers unloading, a Gun set up manned, and vehicles leaving the map.
The counters are the catalog's: the SPW 251/1, the PzKpfw IIIH, the Opel Blitz towing the leIG 18, the T-34 M41, and the 45mm PTP obr. 32.

place: A road west of the Don, Russia
introduction: A German column with a towed infantry gun pushes along a road toward the river, where a Russian rearguard waits with an anti-tank gun and one tank.

friendlyEdge.note: A20.53: the Russians set up in hexrows 5 to 10 with no enemy between them and the south edge.

sides.balance: Add one 4-4-7 squad to the Russian OB.

friendlyEdge.note: A20.53: the Germans enter along the north edge.

sides.balance: Add one LMG to the German OB.

areas.limit: The whole group enters along the north edge on Turn 1, the vehicles in Motion and loaded as they choose (A2.52).

specialRules.text: EC are Moderate, with no wind; the weather is Clear. Grain is in season.
specialRules.note: The Clear weather is the game's default (R16.9); the scenario month, August, puts grain in season.

specialRules.text: The German vehicles enter in Motion; the squad and leader may enter as Passengers of the halftrack, and the crew as a Passenger of the truck towing the infantry gun.
specialRules.note: A2.52 allows it without an SSR; the setup places the Passengers and the towed Gun (ruling R26.1).

specialRules.text: The Russian 45mm gun may set up hidden, with its crew, if Emplaced in Concealment Terrain.
specialRules.note: A12.34 allows it without an SSR (ruling R26.5).

victoryConditions.text: The Germans win at once when they have exited at least 8 Exit VP off the south edge on or adjacent to hexes 4G10, 4Q10, or 4Y10 (a vehicle is worth its VP and its Passengers theirs, a Gun 2). Otherwise the Russians win.

aftermath: A manufactured test of vehicles and Guns on a card; it has no history.
